review_scope: B3 measured geometry and full quadrature
sealed original prefix and fixed candidate branches
observations: No source asset dimensions/mesh consumed by new geometry or likelihood method; actual RGBD history and measured quality only.
G/S share geometry, evidence, candidate set and code; semantic prior only differs in regular G/S arms.
S_no_geometry deliberately changes S geometry; within-arm counterfactual G/S values there are not pure semantic comparisons.
S_no_history now removes measured-surface reward consumption only; retained free rejection and visibility are explicit. This differs from historical B2 combined-history ablation.
Full quadrature uses shared raw sample basis, history represented by zero weights; old 3500 point thinning removed.

Recorded12 author tests reviewed, covering B2 integral parity, opposite/partial face fit, vertical extent, depth boundaries, duplicate history and ablation separation. No need to repeat tests without code change.
Fixed-candidate branches clone exact measured TSDF and execute no new policy selection; outcomes shared across predicted-model stages.
Evaluator six independent unit tests and two old B2 interval compatibility checks passed; all8 primary/secondary prediction dictionaries exactly reproduce existing evidence.
limits: Yaw/extent estimator is a partial envelope point estimate, not a full shape optimization or calibrated posterior. Internal shelf faces can still be mistaken for envelope faces.
Observation support still cropped to0.12<z<1.8m; unknown upper extent and grounded-object assumption retained explicitly.
Free-space likelihood reuses discrepancy scales as heuristic pseudo-likelihood; no probabilistic calibration claim.
Same source-supported prediction ratio can improve through lower predicted mass; require absolute supported and realized weight plus actual gross/new/lost source area.
No source-to-quadrature-point5cm recall: original quadrature spacing up to0.22m makes it a discretization artifact.
Candidate rank summaries must pair within each of6states then aggregate states equally; all66branches are dependent development evidence.
No promotion based only on G/S divergence. Closed-loop benefit remains untested.
